skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — add a natural-sounding English voiceover that reads my script over the vid...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Voiceover, enabling users to add natural-sounding English narration to videos using AI.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB, with automatic voiceover generation in 30–60 seconds.
- One-step onboarding: automatic token generation and session setup for immediate use.
- Simple upload, edit, and export workflow, ideal for content creators, marketers, and educators.
- Cloud GPU rendering produces 1080p MP4 downloads with no need for local software or advanced editing skills.
